name: @stackra/testing
purpose: Centralised Vitest preset + test-authoring toolkit for the Figentra platform.
capabilities: Vitest presets for Node, NestJS+Fastify, Cloudflare Workers, and React+jsdom
createAssertableProxy - recording proxy with fluent assertions
defineFactory + Sequence + deterministic Rng for typed fixture builders
NestJS test host (Fastify + supertest) and TestingModule builder
Miniflare-driven D1, KV, Durable Object fixtures
PGlite in-process Postgres with per-test transaction rollback
React Testing Library render wrapper + user-event re-export
when_to_use: Every package/service/worker/app in the workspace merges the appropriate preset. Author mocks with createAssertableProxy; author fixtures via createD1Fixture / createPgliteDatabase.
when_not_to_use: React Native applications (apps/family) stay on Jest via @react-native/jest-preset until Vitest's native transformer story improves.
